question: The next card in our opening fight is Terrifying Roar. What do we resolve, in what order, and which printed source are you using for those instructions?

record.title: First Story: White Lion
record.keywords: prologue showdown setup ai deck claw chomp size up power swat grasp maul terrifying roar enraged strange hand six spaces
record.layout: Numbered instructions connect to blue numbered markers in a board diagram. AI deck list has Basic, Advanced, and Legendary groupings. Card-back images distinguish AI, hit location, and resource cards.
record.summary: The First Story uses a predetermined White Lion AI deck. Basic: Claw, Chomp, Size Up, Power Swat, Grasp. Advanced: Maul, Terrifying Roar, Enraged. No Legendary cards.
notes: Set Claw aside, shuffle the rest face down, then place Claw face down on top.
Set Strange Hand aside from hit locations, shuffle the rest face down, then place Strange Hand face down on top.
Place the double-sided Basic Action / Monster Reference card on the monster control panel.
Arrange survivor records and gear grids around the showdown board.
Place the White Lion in the board center. Place each survivor 6 spaces away, counting cardinally, not diagonally, on the blue diagram spaces.

response.answer:
The reviewed **First Story: White Lion** record establishes that Terrifying Roar is an Advanced card in the predetermined opening-fight AI deck. It does **not** include the card’s instructions, so I can’t establish what to resolve or in what order.

The missing printed source is the **Terrifying Roar AI card**. If its instructions refer to another rule or card, that printed text would also be needed.
